the EPS and organic carbon secreted controlled the dissemination of calcareous crystals in marine biofilm isolates.

extrinsic factors like EPS, organic carbon and nutrition play a major role in controlling the precipitation of the crystals and the intrinsic factors like pH, temperature, ionic strength, etc., have a minimal effect.

the EPS concentration, organic carbon, and the nutrition of the isolates play a significant role in the nucleation and growth of the calcareously precipitated crystals.
